tldr: Venus through the 1st house softens your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When Venus moves through your 1st house, it draws your attention toward your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
